# core/bytesmap.bastio

<!-- Generated by tests/libref.py from core/bytesmap.bastio: edit the source, then run tests/libref.py --write. -->

A hash map from byte strings to values of any type
`V` that can be copied, for symbol tables, paths and names.

The map owns copies of its keys, packed into one byte arena: slot `i`'s
key is `arena[starts[i] .. starts[i] + lens[i]]`. Open addressing with
linear probing and tombstones, as `core/hashmap.bastio`; growing the
table also compacts the arena. Lookups take a `&Bytes` and never copy it.

What is proved: every index is in bounds (each slot's key lies inside the
arena), `len` is the number of keys and `used` the number of slots that
are not empty, a slot a lookup returns holds exactly the bytes asked for,
and after `bmap_insert` the map holds the key with the new value. Not
proved, as for `HashMap`: that a lookup finds every key present.

`import "core/bytesmap.bastio";` also loads [core/option.bastio](core-option.md), [core/bytes.bastio](core-bytes.md).

| Function | |
| --- | --- |
| [`bmap_with_cap`](#bmap_with_cap) | An empty map with room for `cap` slots (at least 8). |
| [`bmap_new`](#bmap_new) | An empty map with room for 8 keys before it grows. |
| [`bmap_len`](#bmap_len) | The number of keys in the map. |
| [`bmap_contains`](#bmap_contains) | `k` is in the map. |
| [`bmap_get`](#bmap_get) | The value of `k`. |
| [`bmap_get_or`](#bmap_get_or) | The value of `k`, or `d` if `k` is not in the map. |
| [`bmap_insert`](#bmap_insert) | Sets the value of `k` to `v`, copying `k` into the map if it is new. |
| [`bmap_remove`](#bmap_remove) | Takes `k` out of the map. |
| [`bmap_key`](#bmap_key) | A copy of the key in slot `i`, which holds one. |
| [`bmap_free`](#bmap_free) | Frees the map, its keys and its arena. |

Every example below is built, verified and run by `tests/run.sh`. An `assert` in one is proved at compile time from the contracts above it.

## Types and constants

### `BytesMap`

```bastio
struct BytesMap[V] {
  arena: Vec[u8],         // every key's bytes, back to back
  starts: Vec[u64],       // where slot i's key starts in the arena
  lens: Vec[u64],         // and its length
  hashes: Vec[u64],       // bytes_hash of slot i's key
  vals: Vec[Option[V]],   // None in a slot that has never held a key
  tags: Vec[u8],          // 0 empty, 1 removed (a tombstone), 2 holds a key
  len: u64,               // slots holding a key
  used: u64,              // slots holding a key or a tombstone
}
```

## Functions

### `bmap_with_cap`

```bastio
fn bmap_with_cap[V](cap: u64) -> BytesMap[V]
  requires 8 <= cap && cap <= 1152921504606846976
  ensures bmap_ok[V](result) && result.len == 0 && vlen(result.tags) == cap
```

An empty map with room for `cap` slots (at least 8).

Example:

```bastio
let mut m = bmap_with_cap[u64](64);
let k = bfrom("/etc/passwd");
let a = bmap_insert[u64](&mut m, k, 3);
let has = bmap_contains[u64](m, k);
let mut got = 0;
match bmap_get[u64](m, k) {
  Option::Some(v) => { got = v; },
  Option::None => {},
}
let gone = bmap_remove[u64](&mut m, k);
let ok = has && got == 3 && gone is Option::Some && !bmap_contains[u64](m, k);
bfree(k);
bmap_free[u64](m);
if !ok { return 1; }
```

### `bmap_new`

```bastio
fn bmap_new[V]() -> BytesMap[V]
  ensures bmap_ok[V](result) && result.len == 0
```

An empty map with room for 8 keys before it grows.

Example:

```bastio
// Counting words: the map copies each key it is given.
let text = bfrom("to be or not to be");
let words = bytes_split(text, 32);
let mut m = bmap_new[u64]();
let mut i = 0;
while i < vec_len(words)
  invariant i <= vlen(words) && bmap_ok[u64](m)
  invariant forall k: u64 :: k < vlen(words) ==> span_in(vget(words, k), text)
{
  let w = vec_get(words, i);
  let key = bytes_slice(text, w.start, w.end);
  let n = bmap_get_or[u64](m, key, 0);
  if n < 1000 {
    let prev = bmap_insert[u64](&mut m, key, n + 1);
  }
  bfree(key);
  i = i + 1;
}
let to = bfrom("to");
let ok = bmap_len[u64](m) == 4 && bmap_get_or[u64](m, to, 0) == 2;
bfree(to);
vec_free(words);
bfree(text);
bmap_free[u64](m);
if !ok { return 1; }
```

### `bmap_len`

```bastio
fn bmap_len[V](m: &BytesMap[V]) -> u64
  ensures result == m.len
```

The number of keys in the map.

### `bmap_contains`

```bastio
fn bmap_contains[V](m: &BytesMap[V], k: &Bytes) -> bool
  requires bmap_ok[V](m)
  ensures result ==> bmap_has[V](m, k)
```

`k` is in the map.

### `bmap_get`

```bastio
fn bmap_get[V](m: &BytesMap[V], k: &Bytes) -> Option[V]
  requires bmap_ok[V](m)
  ensures result is Option::Some ==> bmap_maps[V](m, k, result.Some)
```

The value of `k`.

### `bmap_get_or`

```bastio
fn bmap_get_or[V](m: &BytesMap[V], k: &Bytes, d: V) -> V
  requires bmap_ok[V](m)
  ensures result == d || bmap_maps[V](m, k, result)
```

The value of `k`, or `d` if `k` is not in the map.

### `bmap_insert`

```bastio
fn bmap_insert[V](m: &mut BytesMap[V], k: &Bytes, v: V) -> Option[V]
  requires bmap_ok[V](m)
  ensures bmap_ok[V](m) && bmap_maps[V](m, k, v)
```

Sets the value of `k` to `v`, copying `k` into the map if it is new.
Returns the value it replaces, if `k` was already there.

### `bmap_remove`

```bastio
fn bmap_remove[V](m: &mut BytesMap[V], k: &Bytes) -> Option[V]
  requires bmap_ok[V](m)
  ensures bmap_ok[V](m)
```

Takes `k` out of the map. Returns its value, if it was there. Its bytes
stay in the arena until the table next grows.

### `bmap_key`

```bastio
fn bmap_key[V](m: &BytesMap[V], i: u64) -> Bytes
  requires bmap_ok[V](m) && i < vlen(m.tags) && vget(m.tags, i) == 2
  ensures bmap_key_at[V](m, i, result)
```

A copy of the key in slot `i`, which holds one: for walking the map in
slot order (`i` from 0 to the capacity, where the tag is 2).

Example:

```bastio
let mut m = bmap_new[u64]();
let a = bfrom("alpha");
let prev = bmap_insert[u64](&mut m, a, 1);
// Walk the slots; a slot whose tag is 2 holds a key.
let mut found = 0;
let mut i = 0;
while i < vec_len(m.tags)
  invariant i <= vlen(m.tags) && bmap_ok[u64](m) && found <= i
{
  if vec_get(m.tags, i) == 2 {
    let k = bmap_key[u64](m, i);
    if bytes_eq(k, a) { found = found + 1; }
    bfree(k);
  }
  i = i + 1;
}
bfree(a);
bmap_free[u64](m);
if found != 1 { return 1; }
```

### `bmap_free`

```bastio
fn bmap_free[V](m: BytesMap[V])
```

Frees the map, its keys and its arena.

## Specification functions

### `bmap_ok`

```bastio
spec fn bmap_ok[V](m: &BytesMap[V]) -> bool {
  vlen(m.starts) == vlen(m.tags) && vlen(m.lens) == vlen(m.tags)
    && vlen(m.hashes) == vlen(m.tags) && vlen(m.vals) == vlen(m.tags)
    && 8 <= vlen(m.tags) && vlen(m.tags) <= 1152921504606846976
    && vcount(m.tags, 0) + vcount(m.tags, 1) + vcount(m.tags, 2) == vlen(m.tags)
    && m.len == vcount(m.tags, 2) && m.used + vcount(m.tags, 0) == vlen(m.tags)
    && m.len <= m.used && m.used < vlen(m.tags)
    && (forall i: u64 :: i < vlen(m.tags) && vget(m.tags, i) == 2 ==>
          vget(m.starts, i) <= vlen(m.arena) && vget(m.lens, i) <= vlen(m.arena) - vget(m.starts, i))
}
```

What every map function needs and keeps: the slot vectors have one
length, the capacity is in range, every tag is 0, 1 or 2, `len` and
`used` count, some slot is still empty, and every slot holding a key
names bytes inside the arena.

### `bmap_key_at`

```bastio
spec fn bmap_key_at[V](m: &BytesMap[V], i: u64, k: &Bytes) -> bool {
  i < vlen(m.tags) && vget(m.tags, i) == 2 && vget(m.lens, i) == blen(k)
    && (forall j: u64 :: j < blen(k) ==> vget(m.arena, vget(m.starts, i) + j) == bget(k, j))
}
```

Slot `i` holds a key with the same bytes as `k`.

### `bmap_maps`

```bastio
spec fn bmap_maps[V](m: &BytesMap[V], k: &Bytes, v: V) -> bool {
  !(forall i: u64 :: i < vlen(m.tags) ==>
      !(bmap_key_at[V](m, i, k) && vget(m.vals, i) is Option::Some && vget(m.vals, i).Some == v))
}
```

The map holds key `k` with value `v`.

### `bmap_has`

```bastio
spec fn bmap_has[V](m: &BytesMap[V], k: &Bytes) -> bool {
  !(forall i: u64 :: i < vlen(m.tags) ==> !bmap_key_at[V](m, i, k))
}
```

The map holds key `k`.

## Internals

### `bmap_slot_is`

```bastio
fn bmap_slot_is[V](m: &BytesMap[V], i: u64, k: &Bytes) -> bool
  requires bmap_ok[V](m) && i < vlen(m.tags) && vget(m.tags, i) == 2
  ensures result == bmap_key_at[V](m, i, k)
```

Internal: Whether slot `i`, which holds a key, holds exactly the bytes of `k`.

### `bmap_find`

```bastio
fn bmap_find[V](m: &BytesMap[V], k: &Bytes) -> u64
  requires bmap_ok[V](m)
  ensures result <= vlen(m.tags)
  ensures result < vlen(m.tags) ==> bmap_key_at[V](m, result, k)
```

Internal: The slot holding `k`, or the capacity if `k` is not in the map.

### `bmap_place`

```bastio
fn bmap_place[V](m: &mut BytesMap[V], h: u64, s: u64, n: u64, v: V) -> u64
  requires bmap_ok[V](m) && (m.used + 1) * 4 <= vlen(m.tags) * 3
  requires s <= vlen(m.arena) && n <= vlen(m.arena) - s
  ensures bmap_ok[V](m) && result < vlen(m.tags) && vget(m.tags, result) == 2
  ensures vget(m.starts, result) == s && vget(m.lens, result) == n
  ensures vget(m.vals, result) is Option::Some && vget(m.vals, result).Some == v
  ensures vlen(m.tags) == vlen(old(m).tags) && vlen(m.arena) == vlen(old(m).arena) && m.len == old(m).len + 1
  ensures forall q: u64 :: q < vlen(m.arena) ==> vget(m.arena, q) == vget(old(m).arena, q)
```

Internal: Puts a key already in the arena (`s .. s + n`, hash `h`) into the first
empty slot of its probe sequence. The caller has made sure there is
room: `used + 1` stays below three quarters of the table.

### `bmap_grow`

```bastio
fn bmap_grow[V](m: &mut BytesMap[V])
  requires bmap_ok[V](m)
  ensures bmap_ok[V](m)
```

Internal: Rebuilds the table without tombstones and with a compacted arena,
doubling it when at least half of it holds keys.

### `bmap_reserve`

```bastio
fn bmap_reserve[V](m: &mut BytesMap[V])
  requires bmap_ok[V](m)
  ensures bmap_ok[V](m) && (m.used + 1) * 4 <= vlen(m.tags) * 3
```

Internal: Grows the table until one more key fits under three quarters.

### `bmap_append`

```bastio
fn bmap_append[V](m: &mut BytesMap[V], src: &Vec[u8], s: u64, n: u64) -> u64
  requires bmap_ok[V](m) && s <= vlen(src) && n <= vlen(src) - s
  ensures bmap_ok[V](m) && result == vlen(old(m).arena) && vlen(m.arena) == result + n
  ensures m.used == old(m).used && vlen(m.tags) == vlen(old(m).tags)
  ensures forall q: u64 :: q < n ==> vget(m.arena, result + q) == vget(src, s + q)
```

Internal: Appends bytes `s .. s + n` of `src` to the arena; returns where they start.
